title: Sessions: saved sessions on the left, the setup and saved players on the right
covers: Sessions screen: list, setup form, saved players with the direct switch
context: Sessions holds configuration only. The list of saved sessions is on the left and the setup of the picked one is on the right: name, How players join, the world settings and the saved players, each with a switch that lets them connect directly. There is no lobby, no address and no runs list on this screen. Runs are in History.
changed: views/Sessions: ListDetailLayout with the SessionBuilder form
views/SessionBuilder: buttons by state, unsaved changes text, History link

steps: Open Sessions in the s The list is on the left (heading Sessions With none saved the list reads No sess New session builds and the right side reads Pick a session to see its setup and its players
The header has New session; the list has Join a session.

Press New sess The page holds the name box, the buttons Save and run and Save, the card How players join (rows Where, Allow direct connections, Room password), the world settings and a Players s No lobby, address or runs list is
Press Add player and set Name to Host1 and Game to A Link to the Pas Press Save: the mark Saved shows.
Press Back. The row Setup check shows its place, its player count and never run. Pick it. The detail shows the same setup, the button Run, and a link History of this session (0 runs).

Turn on Allow direct connections. In the Players grid turn on the switch Lets Host1 connect directly (the Direct column). The header reads n unsaved changes. Run is replaced by Run once with these changes, Save and run, Save and Discard.
Turn Allow direct connections off again while Host1 is still s Run once and Save and run are greyed out with the reason: A player is s Turn on Allow direct connections, or switch that player off.
Press Discard. The name, the switch and the player go back to the saved values, and the button is Run again.
Change the name and then pick another row in the list. A question titled Leave this session? offers Discard changes and Keep editing. Press Keep editing.
Open the menu of the row (More actions for Setup check). Duplicate makes a copy. Delete asks first and removes it. Delete the copy.
pass: The list is on the left and the setup on the right, with no lobby, address or runs list on the screen.
The players grid has a Direct switch per player. A direct player on a session with direct connections off blocks Run with a clear reason.
The buttons follow the state: Run when nothing changed, Run once with these changes, Save and run, Save and Discard when it changed.
Leaving a session with unsaved changes asks first. Duplicate and Delete work from the row menu.
fail: A lobby, a session code, an address or a Runs card shows on the Sessions screen.
Run still shows after a change, or a direct player on a session with direct off does not block Run.
Pick another row drops unsaved changes without asking.
notes: Run and Run once are in the next test. The History link is covered in the test History.
Where (Local, LAN, Remote) and the LAN question are in the test Where and LAN.
A direct player can stay without a game: it holds the seat for that name. A game set on it is the fallback if the player has not joined at Run.
